method.block_signal: sum standardized local statistics / sqrt(block prime count)
method.confirmation_gate: fixed selection shortlist rescored on a second disjoint interval; retain positive confirmation total z and positive confirmation one-SE ensemble lower score, then order by confirmation lower score
method.local_statistic: (Nagao contribution - P1 good-fibre mean) / P1 good-fibre population standard deviation
method.singular_reduction_imputation: prime mean, hence standardized contribution zero; bad count retained
method.stability_audit: competition ranks for every leave-one-block-out total

proof_boundary: Fresh-prime centered/standardized Nagao scores and ensemble stability are heuristic parameter-ranking evidence only. They do not prove a rank jump, a point, an upper bound, or parity.
